text: Wallpaper Engine Background 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的壁纸背景插件：在设置页选择本机 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊目录后，它扫描壁纸标题和预览图，并可将 scene.pkg 的纹理图层合成为静态背景。你可以按名称或 ID 搜索并选择壁纸，调整面板透明度、背景模糊、压暗和亮度，也可选择动图预览。适合想用个人壁纸美化 DSH 界面的用户；需要本机壁纸库及浏览器目录读取能力，不需要 API 密钥。

Use a local Wallpaper Engine library as the DSH web backdrop. Browse and search wallpapers, select one, and adjust opacity, blur, dimming, or brightness. Scene layers can be composited as a still image, with animated previews optional. Requires local library access; no API key.
想把自己的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸用作 DSH 的应用背景
能不能在 DSH 里浏览本地创意工坊壁纸并挑一张当背景？
I want to choose a wallpaper from my local Wallpaper Engine library for the DSH background.
Wallpaper Engine Background 的功能「壁纸库选择」：在设置页选择创意工坊文件夹后，插件读取每张壁纸的标题和预览图，并提供按标题或 ID 搜索的网格供选择。
Wallpaper Engine Background 的功能「背景外观调整」：选中壁纸后可调面板透明度、背景模糊、压暗和亮度；scene.pkg 会合成静态图层，也可优先使用可用的动图预览。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Wallpaper Engine Background for DeepSeek Harness：Browse your own **Wallpaper Engine** library and use it as the DeepSeek Harness
app background, with frosted translucent panels.

Unlike most theme plugins, this one reads your actual workshop library — and for
`scene` wallpapers it **renders the scene's texture layers** out of `scene.pkg`,
so you get the artwork itself rather than one layer of it or the ~768 px
`preview.jpg` thumbnail.

> frame** per wallpaper. If you want the real thing — scene wallpapers rendered
> live in WebGL (particles, puppet rigs, SceneScript, mouse parallax), video
> wallpapers played and transcoded, web wallpapers sandboxed with the WE API,
> system audio reaction, liquid-glass UI — use

> instead. That is the mature DSH plugin for this job, and it is a different

text:
dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Features：- **Reads your real Wallpaper Engine library** — points at your Steam workshop
  folder and lists every subscribed wallpaper with its title.
- **Full-resolution artwork** — a `scene.pkg` holds the picture as a stack of
  texture layers (plus masks, sprite sheets and shaders) that Wallpaper Engine
  blends at runtime. This plugin parses the container, decodes the layers —
  stored PNG/JPEG streams, raw RGBA, DXT5/DXT1, LZ4-compressed or not — and
  composites them in scene order. That gets you the original 1920×1080 /
  3840×2160 art instead of one arbitrary layer or the small preview thumbnail.
- **Animated previews** — many wallpapers ship an animated `preview.gif`
  instead of a still. The picker marks those with a 动 badge, and a toggle lets
  you prefer the animation over the sharper composited still.
- **Picker with search** — thumbnail grid, filter by title or workshop id.
- **Four live sliders** — panel opacity, wallpaper blur, background dim, and
  wallpaper brightness. Everything is persisted per browser.
- **Light and dark aware** — the overlay tint follows the app's colour scheme,
  so text stays readable in both.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with a Web GUI profile.
- Wallpaper Engine installed via Steam (any platform).
- A Chromium-based browser or the DSH desktop app (needs the directory picker
  and Blob URLs).

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Install：From a checkout of this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin install /absolute/path/to/dsh-wallpaper-engine
```

Or, from inside a DSH session, ask the agent to run `plugin_manager` with
`action: install_bundle` and `target` set to this directory.

Then enable **Wallpaper Engine Background** in *Settings → Plugins* if it is not
already on.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Usage：1. Open **Settings → Wallpaper Engine 壁纸**.
2. Click **Choose Wallpaper Engine folder** and select your workshop content
   directory:
   - Windows: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\431960`
     (or wherever your Steam library lives — the folder is named after
     Wallpaper Engine's Steam app id, `431960`)
   - Linux: `~/.steam/steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960`
   - macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960`
3. Pick a wallpaper from the grid, then tune the sliders.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Usage：> **New wallpapers.** There is no filesystem watcher — the browser exposes no
> directory-change event — so a wallpaper you download in Wallpaper Engine will
> not appear by itself. Press **Rescan** in the settings page (or reload), and it
> is picked up.
>
> **Across a browser restart.** The folder handle is stored in IndexedDB. When
> the browser still grants read access the library reloads by itself; when the
> grant has lapsed back to "prompt" (which needs a user gesture), a one-click
> **Grant access and scan** button appears instead. That is a browser security
> rule, not a bug.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · How it works：The whole plugin is client-side.

1. **Scan.** Reading the chosen directory gives you one subfolder per wallpaper,
   each with a `project.json` (which carries the title) and either a
   `preview.jpg` / `preview.gif` or a `scene.pkg`.

2. **List.** Titles and small thumbnails build the picker. Only the tiny preview
   files are read at this stage, so listing a large library stays cheap.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · How it works：3. **Render.** When you select a `scene` wallpaper, its `scene.pkg` is parsed:
   the PKGV file table, `scene.json`'s object list, and each object's
   model → material → `.tex` chain. Textures are decoded (stored PNG/JPEG
   streams, raw RGBA, DXT5/DXT1, single channel masks — LZ4-compressed when the
   container says so) and composited bottom-up at 1920 px wide, which is the
   picture Wallpaper Engine would show. This happens only for the wallpaper you
   actually select.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · How it works：4. **Apply.** The artwork becomes a Blob URL on a `position: fixed;
   z-index: -1` layer behind the app. Because every ancestor of that layer
   paints its own background *above* a negative-z-index child, the frame's
   background is cleared, and `theme.overrideTokens()` makes the panel tokens
   translucent — which is the only way to change them, since the theme
   presenter writes them as inline styles on `<body>`.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Development：The plugin is one hand-written browser file, `client.js`, and it has no build
step: edit it, then reload the DSH window (a hard reload, because the client
module is cached).

The scene renderer — everything between `#region scene-renderer` and
`#endregion scene-renderer` — is deliberately kept free of React and of DOM
APIs except `document.createElement('canvas')`, `createImageBitmap` and
`Blob`, so it can be evaluated headlessly:

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Development：```sh
node test/scene-render.mjs 2372608028            # composite -> test/out/*.png
node test/scene-render.mjs 2372608028 --layers   # per-object placement report
WPE_LIBRARY=~/.steam/steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960 node test/scene-render.mjs ...
```

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Development：The harness shims a canvas into Node, so it renders with the same code the
browser runs; only JPEG mips need a real browser (`createImageBitmap`), which is
why a wallpaper whose artwork is a single JPEG stream reports `no layers` there.
It is how this renderer was checked against a Python reference implementation
and against the wallpapers' own preview images: identical layer stacks for all
63 scene packages in the sampled library, and pixel-identical composites
(mean channel difference ≤ 2.2) for the sampled ids.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Limitations：- **Video wallpapers are not played.** Wallpapers of type `video` carry an
  `.mp4` instead of a `scene.pkg`. Decoding video behind the UI would cost CPU
  continuously, so this plugin uses their preview file instead — which, when it
  is a `preview.gif`, happens to animate for free.
- **The animated option trades sharpness for motion.** A `preview.gif` is a few
  hundred pixels wide, so preferring it over the composited `scene.pkg` artwork
  is visibly softer. In the sampled library 36 of 86 wallpapers had an animated
  preview, and 21 of those also had a `scene.pkg` — meaning the toggle actually
  changes the result for them.
- **Some scenes fall back to their preview.** A scene whose subject is a puppet
  (a bone-deformed mesh, which is a rasteriser of its own) or a script-driven
  layer composites to a partial or flat picture. When that happens the preview
  image is used instead — blurry, but the actual artwork. In the sampled library
  this affected 2 of 63 scene packages.
- **Sprite sheets are skipped.** An animation atlas drawn whole would show every
  frame at once, so those objects are left out; they are the falling petals and
  s

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Credits and disclaimer：This plugin is unofficial. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored
by Wallpaper Engine (Kristjan Skutta) or DeepSeek; their names are used
descriptively, to say what this plugin works with and where it runs.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Credits and disclaimer：No artwork ships in this repository. The plugin reads the wallpaper files you
already have on your own machine, composites them in memory and puts the result
behind the UI as a Blob URL — nothing is uploaded, copied into the repository or
redistributed. What you display stays under its own licence, and Wallpaper
Engine's terms continue to apply to the files it downloaded.

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · Credits and disclaimer：The file-format knowledge behind the scene renderer — the PKGV container, the
TEXV/TEXB texture containers, the LZ4 block layout, DXT blocks — is public
community reverse-engineering. The implementations here were written against the
file layouts themselves and checked layer by layer against real packages; no
code from any other project is included. Prior art worth naming, and worth
reading if you want the same formats explained from another angle:
[RePKG](https://github.com/notscuffed/repkg) and
[linux-wallpaperengine](https://github.com/Almamu/linux-wallpaperengine).
dsh-wallpaper-engine README · License：MIT. Wallpaper artwork belongs to its respective authors — this plugin reads the files on your own machine and ships none of them. ---

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 中文说明：把你自己的 **Wallpaper Engine** 壁纸库用作 DeepSeek Harness 的应用背景，面板半透明磨砂。

和大多数主题插件不同，这个插件读的是你**真实的创意工坊壁纸库**；对于 `scene` 类型的壁纸，它会把 `scene.pkg` 里的**图层合成成完整原画**，而不是只取其中一层、也不是将就那张约 768px 的 `preview.jpg` 缩略图。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 中文说明：> **想让壁纸真的动起来？** 本插件每张壁纸只合成**一张静态帧**。如果你要的是完整效果 —— 场景壁纸用 WebGL **实时渲染**（粒子、puppet 骨骼、SceneScript 脚本、鼠标视差）、视频壁纸直接播放并转码、网页壁纸沙箱挂载 + WE API、系统音频反应、液态玻璃界面 —— 请用 **[elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine)**。那才是做这件事的成熟 DSH 插件；**它和本项目只是名字相近，是两个不同项目**。本仓库的价值在于：一个无依赖的小型静态帧合成器，以及一份可读的 `scene.pkg` / `.tex` 图层格式参考实现。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 特点：- **读取你真实的壁纸库** —— 指向你的 Steam 创意工坊目录，列出每一张订阅壁纸的名称。
- **全分辨率原图** —— `scene.pkg` 里的画面其实是**一堆贴图图层**（外加遮罩、精灵图集、着色器），由 Wallpaper Engine 在运行时按顺序混合而成。本插件解析 PKGV 容器，解码各图层（内嵌 PNG/JPEG 流、原始 RGBA、DXT5/DXT1、单通道遮罩，按标记决定是否 LZ4 解压），再按场景顺序合成。拿到的是原始 1920×1080 / 3840×2160 画面，而不是随便一层贴图或小预览图。
- **支持动态壁纸** —— 不少壁纸用的是会动的 `preview.gif` 而不是静态图。选择器会给这类壁纸打上「动」标记，并有开关让你在「动图」和「更清晰的合成原图」之间二选一。
- **带搜索的选择器** —— 缩略图网格，可按名称或创意工坊 ID 过滤。
- **四个实时滑块** —— 面板透明度、壁纸模糊、背景压暗、壁纸亮度。设置按浏览器保存。
- **适配明暗主题** —— 叠加色调跟随应用配色，两种模式下文字都清晰。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 安装：在仓库目录下执行：

```sh
dsh plugin install /本仓库的绝对路径/dsh-wallpaper-engine
```

或者，在 DSH 会话里让 agent 调用 `plugin_manager`，`action: install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录。

然后在 **设置 → 插件** 里确认「Wallpaper Engine 壁纸」已启用。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 使用：1. 打开 **设置 → Wallpaper Engine 壁纸**。
2. 点 **选择文件夹…**，选中你的创意工坊内容目录：
   - Windows：`C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\431960`
     （或者你 Steam 库所在的位置；`431960` 是 Wallpaper Engine 的 Steam app id）
   - Linux：`~/.steam/steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960`
   - macOS：`~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960`
3. 在网格里选一张壁纸，然后用滑块调整观感。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 使用：> **新下载的壁纸。** 没有文件系统监听 —— 浏览器不提供目录变更事件 —— 所以你在 Wallpaper Engine 里新下载的壁纸不会自己冒出来。在设置页点一下 **「重新扫描」**（或者刷新页面）就会读到。
>
> **浏览器重启后。** 文件夹句柄存在 IndexedDB 里。浏览器仍保留读取授权时，壁纸库会自动恢复；授权回退成"需要询问"时（这种情况必须要用户点一下），界面会显示一个 **「恢复授权并扫描」** 按钮，点一次即可。这是浏览器的安全规定，不是 bug。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 工作原理：1. **扫描**：读你选中的目录，每张壁纸是一个子文件夹，里面有 `project.json`（存标题），以及 `preview.jpg` / `preview.gif` 或 `scene.pkg`。
2. **列清单**：标题 + 小缩略图构成选择器。这一步只读很小的预览文件，所以即使壁纸库很大也很快。
3. **合成**：当你选中一张 `scene` 壁纸时，解析它的 `scene.pkg`：PKGV 文件表、`scene.json` 的对象列表，以及每个对象的 模型 → 材质 → `.tex` 链路。贴图被逐一解码（内嵌 PNG/JPEG 流、原始 RGBA、DXT5/DXT1、单通道遮罩，容器标记为 LZ4 时先解压），然后自下而上合成成 1920px 宽的整幅画面 —— 也就是 Wallpaper Engine 会显示的那张图。**只对你实际选中的那张做这件事。**
4. **应用**：原画变成一个 Blob URL，放在 `position: fixed; z-index: -1` 的层上。由于 CSS 绘制顺序里所有普通块级元素（`html`、`body`、`#root`、应用框架）都画在负层级元素**之上**，必须把框架背景清成透明，并用 `theme.overrideTokens()` 把面板 token 改成半透明 —— 这是唯一可行的办法，因为主题呈现器把这些 token 作为**内联样式写在 `<body>` 上**，CSS 规则（哪怕加了 `!important`）都盖不过它。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 开发：整个插件就是一个手写的浏览器文件 `client.js`，**没有构建步骤**：改完刷新 DSH 窗口即可（要硬刷新，客户端模块有缓存）。

场景合成器（`client.js` 里 `#region scene-renderer` 到 `#endregion scene-renderer` 之间）刻意不依赖 React，除 `document.createElement('canvas')`、`createImageBitmap`、`Blob` 外不碰 DOM，所以可以脱离浏览器跑：

```sh
node test/scene-render.mjs 2372608028            # 合成，输出到 test/out/*.png
node test/scene-render.mjs 2372608028 --layers   # 逐对象打印摆放结果
WPE_LIBRARY=~/.steam/steam/steamapps/workshop/content/431960 node test/scene-render.mjs ...
```

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 开发：这个 harness 在 Node 里垫了一个 canvas，跑的是浏览器里同一份代码；只有 JPEG 的 mip 需要真正的浏览器（`createImageBitmap`），所以「原画本身就是单张 JPEG」的壁纸在这里会报 `no layers`。当初就是用它跟一份 Python 参考实现、以及壁纸自带的预览图逐张核对的：抽样库里 63 个场景包的图层栈完全一致，抽样的 id 合成结果逐像素一致（平均通道差 ≤ 2.2）。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 已知限制：- **视频类壁纸不会被播放。** `video` 类型的壁纸是 `.mp4` 而不是 `scene.pkg`。在界面背后持续解码视频会一直占用 CPU，所以这类壁纸用它们的预览文件 —— 而当预览文件是 `preview.gif` 时，它正好是动的，等于白捡了动态效果。
- **动态选项是拿清晰度换动作。** `preview.gif` 只有几百像素宽，所以优先用它会明显比合成的 `scene.pkg` 原图糊。在抽样的壁纸库里，86 张中有 36 张带动态预览，其中 21 张同时也有 `scene.pkg` —— 也就是说对它们而言这个开关是真的会改变效果的。
- **少数场景会回退到预览图。** 如果一张场景壁纸的主体是 puppet（骨骼形变网格，需要单独的网格光栅化器）或者位置由脚本驱动的图层，合成出来就会缺主体、或者是一片纯色；这时改用预览图 —— 糊，但至少是原画。抽样库里 63 个场景包中有 2 个属于这种情况。
- **精灵图集会被跳过。** 动画图集整张贴上去会把所有帧一次显示出来，所以这类对象不参与合成；它们都是飘落的花瓣、火星之类的点缀，从来不是画面主体。
- **不同壁纸的清晰度差别很大**，设置页也会如实告诉你：它会显示合成尺寸和图层数，低于 1280px 的会标黄提醒。原因有两个。一是**源图本身**：抽样库里 Wallpaper Engine 的 `preview.jpg` 从 160px 到 1080px 不等，而某些 `scene.pkg` 的原画本来就是一张小贴图。二是 `background-size: cover` 会按“需要放大更多的那条边”来缩放，所以一张**方形**的 728×728 预览图在宽窗口里是按宽度放大的，放大倍数远高于 1920×1080 的图。把**「壁纸模糊」调高**能相当有效地掩盖低分辨率源图。
- **刷新后可能需要重新选文件夹**，取决于浏览器对目录句柄的持久化行为。
- **Steam 的每张壁纸文件夹以创意工坊 ID 命名**，看不出画面内容；标题来自各自的 `project.json`。

dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 致谢与免责：本插件是非官方作品，与 Wallpaper Engine（作者 Kristjan Skutta）及 DeepSeek **均无隶属、赞助或背书关系**；提及二者的名字只是为了说明它适配什么、跑在哪里。

仓库内**不附带任何壁纸素材**。插件只读取你自己机器上已有的壁纸文件，在内存里合成后作为 Blob URL 放到界面后面 —— 不上传、不复制进仓库、不再分发。你显示的画面版权仍属原作者，Wallpaper Engine 自身的条款也照旧适用于它下载的那些文件。

场景合成用到的格式知识（PKGV 容器、TEXV/TEXB 贴图容器、LZ4 块结构、DXT 块）属于社区公开的逆向成果；本项目的实现是照着文件结构本身写的，并用真实壁纸包逐层验证过，**未包含任何第三方项目的代码**。值得一提的前作（换个角度讲同一套格式，值得一读）：[RePKG](https://github.com/notscuffed/repkg) 与 [linux-wallpaperengine](https://github.com/Almamu/linux-wallpaperengine)。
dsh-wallpaper-engine README · 许可：MIT。壁纸画面的版权属于各自的作者 —— 本插件只读取你自己机器上的文件，不附带任何壁纸。
